description: Add test and clean targets to a Makefile

steps.send: Add two targets to the Makefile: `test`, which runs `python3 -m unittest -q`, and `clean`, which removes every __pycache__ folder. Keep `build` working.

graders.run: make build && mkdir -p __pycache__ sub/__pycache__ && make clean && test ! -d __pycache__ && test ! -d sub/__pycache__
graders.name: make clean
